project_title: AstroGrid: Unified Multi-Messenger Observational Astrophysics Platform
mission: To engineer a scalable, real-time pipeline for processing, calibrating, and analyzing multi-wavelength astronomical data, enabling automated discovery of transient events, precise astrometry, and deep-field characterization through a modular, high-performance computing architecture.
done_criteria: All 25 modules implemented with 95%+ unit test coverage and integrated into a CI/CD pipeline.
End-to-end latency from raw FITS ingestion to VOEvent alert generation under 5 seconds for transient candidates.
Astrometric precision validated against Gaia DR3 reference frame with sub-microarcsecond residuals.
Photometric calibration accuracy within 1% error across all supported filters.
System capable of processing 10TB of raw survey data per day on a standard HPC cluster.
Full API documentation and interactive Jupyter notebook tutorials for all core modules.
Successful simulation of a multi-messenger event (GRB + GW) with correct cross-correlation and alert dispatch.
